description: This file contains API utility functions for user data management within a frontend project. It includes functions to fetch user information, user projects, batch user project data, and user session details via HTTP requests, as well as a helper to wrap ISO strings into MongoDB date format.

methods.name: wrapIsoAsMongoISODate(iso)
methods.description: Wraps an ISO string into a Mongo-shell style ISODate('...') expression, used for formatting timestamps in query parameters.

methods.name: getUserBasic(userId, params = {})
methods.description: Fetches a single user document by ID from the API endpoint /api/users/{id}.

methods.name: getUserProjects(userId, params = {}, options = {})
methods.description: Fetches distinct project data for a user, with optional date filtering, converting 'from' and 'to' parameters into MongoDB ISODate format.

methods.name: getUsersProjectsBatch(body = {}, options = {})
methods.description: Fetches project data for multiple users in a single request, posting user IDs and optional date range as plain ISO strings.

methods.name: getUserSessionDetails(userId, params = {})
methods.description: Retrieves aggregated session details for a specific user, such as total count and duration.
